findAgent.privacyNote: After the term ends you can reassign your property to different agents. The final buyer price will include the platform fee and the agent's commission — you receive your full asking price.

detail.trustBody: Title deed, owner identity and documents were checked by our verification team before this listing went live.

actions.viewingRequested: Viewing requested — the host will confirm
actions.antiBypassNote: For your safety, contact details are hidden in chat until a viewing is confirmed. All deals are protected by the platform.

chat.title: Messages
chat.empty: No conversations yet. Message a lister from any listing page.
chat.anonymousNote: 🔒 Anonymous channel — identities and contact details always stay hidden. A platform representative assists at the deal stage.
chat.scrubNote: Contact details are hidden until a confirmed viewing.
chat.scrubbedFlag: Contact info was hidden in this message

deals.title: Deals
deals.subtitle: Your transactions, tracked from accepted offer to handover.
deals.empty: No deals yet. A deal room opens when an offer is accepted.

next.legal_check: A lawyer reviews the title deed and legal status. Attach findings if needed, then advance.
next.contract_signing: Both parties sign the sale contract. Upload the signed contract to continue.
next.deposit_recorded: The buyer pays the deposit and uploads the receipt for the record.
next.permit_process: Foreign buyers need a purchase permit. Skip this stage if it doesn't apply.
next.completion: Final payment and key handover. A PropVerify representative attends in person. Mark complete when done.
next.application: The renter submits their application and ID.
next.landlord_approval: The landlord reviews and approves the application.
next.contract: Both parties sign the tenancy contract. Upload the signed contract.
next.move_in_checklist: Confirm the move-in condition together. Completing this finalizes the tenancy.
next.renewal_or_exit: Handle renewal or the exit checklist.

room.title: Deal room
room.attachFirst: Attach the required documents before advancing.
room.rateHint: Ratings stay hidden until both sides submit (or after 14 days), so nobody can retaliate.
